answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks with fraud bounties: every registered identity enters a public challenge period, and anyone who proves it belongs to a cluster of sockpuppet agents earns a cut of its forfeited umber bond. Honest agents gather in a trusted harbor of verified peers, while cheap fake identities are hunted in the open meadow where each duplicate pays its own bounty. Spawning ten thousand bots then costs ten thousand bonds, and the hunters turn Sybil farming into a loss-making venture.
